"You are about to delete this audio track Are you sure ?" BookPlayer Manual When you open the app, you’ll see a list of folders — these represent your Books, Lessons, or Podcasts.

A long press on a folder opens the “Modify Folder” screen (rename / delete / reset, etc.).
A tap opens the list of tracks.

A long press on a track opens the “Modify Track” screen.
A tap starts playback. Manual Import : When you manually import a book, you start by selecting a file or a folder.

BookPlayer supports nearly all audio formats, plays video soundtracks, and can extract chapters from ZIP or M4B files.

Option 1: Copy (default) — The file is copied into BookPlayer’s private memory.
Advantages:
  • No permission needed
  • Safe from accidental deletion

Option 2: No Copy — Only the file path is saved. Playback occurs directly from shared storage.
Advantage: Saves internal space.

Note: This is not possible for ZIP, split M4B files and Ebooks. Those are always copied. LibriVox Import: Import Public Domain Audiobooks

Browse the LibriVox catalog of public domain titles by selecting a language.

Tap any book to download it — the audio will be copied to your device and added to your library. Discover Podcasts Explore a wide range of podcasts in many languages.

Stream any episode with a single tap.

Save a podcast as a book by tapping the download button on any episode. Use the top-level button to enable automatic downloads for new episodes.

Tap/DoubleTap the cover image to switch, between live podcast episode list view, and downloaded podcast episode book view.

Check the settings menu to activate an auto-pruning option or to set other preferences. Import from URL : Import via Link

Paste a direct URL to an audio file, ZIP, or M4B.

Tap Import and BookPlayer will fetch and integrate the content.

Everything is handled automatically — unpacking, adding, and making it available for playback. Quick Share: Share Books Between Devices

Quickly share a book between two nearby devices with BookPlayer installed (no internet required).

To Send:
Open a book, then open its settings (top right icon) and tap Quick Share at the bottom.

To Receive:
Tap the three-dot menu (top right) on the main screen and select Quick Share.

Note: Both devices must have Bluetooth and Location/Nearby permissions enabled. Stream World Radios Browse stations by country, popularity, or other available categories, or search for a specific station by name.

Tap a station to start streaming instantly.

Use the heart icon to add a station to your favorites for quick and easy access. Memory Cleaning : Manage Internal Storage

A dedicated screen shows files copied into BookPlayer’s private space.

See which items take up the most space and delete what you no longer need. Storage Location : Where Files Are Stored

By default, BookPlayer uses the SD card if available, to save space. (Note that SD card access is a bit slower than main memory).

To switch to internal storage, change the setting in the Settings menu. Permissions : BookPlayer works even without permissions.

But for full functionality:
  • Read Audio → access external storage
  • Microphone → enable the sound visualizer
  • Location/Bluetooth → enable the quick share function
Denying permissions won’t break the app — BookPlayer adapts. Contact the Developer : Having issues or found a bug?

Please let me know so I can improve the app!

Use the "Mail Developer" option from the menu. Forum : Join the BookPlayer Community

A forum has been set up for:

  • Report bugs
  • Suggest features
  • Share tips and audiobooks
All posts are publicly readable.
